title: Rich: Make Your Terminal Beautiful
analysis: Rich formats CLI output. A progress bar belongs in an interactive terminal; keep structured export separate so color and layout do not change the ledger. The download-volume claim was unnecessary and unverified.

title: Adding Tools to AI Agents
anchor: Start with one or two tools
analysis: When debugging tool choice, hold the model, task set and prompt fixed while adding one tool. Record the first incorrect selection. Changing all three makes the cause of a regression ambiguous.

title: Chrome DevTools MCP = X-ray vision for frontend
analysis: The useful split is between reproducing an interaction and observing the browser during it. Match a failing UI action to console output and a network request in the same test session. Use a disposable profile because the inspector can expose private browser state.

title: The Secret Camera Angles That Make AI Images Look Professional
analysis: The examples mix lens distortion, framing distance and viewpoint. Hold the subject, lighting and seed constant while changing just one of these. The detailed prompt collection is comment-gated; the clip supplies examples, not that collection.

title: How to prompt AI like a pro
analysis: MAPS separates a business objective, requested action, task context and output format. An answer can satisfy the specified format while missing the objective. Check both independently. The claimed universal improvement has no comparison in this clip.

title: AI Agents: The Mind-Blowing Loop Explained #shorts
analysis: Treat each action as a transition with an observable postcondition. For external writes, checking whether the first attempt succeeded before retrying prevents duplicated side effects. The clip provides a conceptual loop, not executable agent software.

title: You're using Claude wrong (here's the 1-time fix)
anchor: Claude interviews you and writes it for you
analysis: A user-reviewed profile can be attached again across chats. This explains portability without assuming how any specific memory setting works. The speaker refers to an exact prompt elsewhere; the frozen transcript does not give its wording.

title: Quiet Interfaces AI Inclusive Short Studio
analysis: The narration describes captions, menu speech, high contrast and a tactile pad. These solve distinct access needs. A software preset cannot substantiate the tactile hardware claim; no device identity or exact preset is supplied.

title: Storytelling secret
analysis: Keep personal observations, third-party reference stories and practice recordings separate. Retrieve a personal anecdote by topic, then compare its pacing with a reference. Retain origin labels to avoid presenting another person’s story as firsthand.

title: Stop chasing every new AI tool — identify your 3 most repeti
analysis: The description supplies the concrete advice missing from the short spoken text: choose three recurring tasks before choosing tools. Use frequency times time spent as a baseline; the clip gives no measurement of savings.

title: Send the Task to Another Machine #Shorts
analysis: The clip describes dispatching a task to a chosen device from a shared list, with execution on owned hardware. A shared account implies a coordination layer; the words do not establish that task payloads stay entirely local. Publisher identity and price remain unresolved.
